purpose: Compare the former serde_yaml_ng parser with serde-saphyr for Bonsai resource frontmatter.
scope: Typed skill and agent fields, not arbitrary YAML or executable instructions.
known_difference: Unquoted YAML null values in required String fields were previously converted to their literal scalar text; the replacement rejects them. Quote the literal or provide a value. The behavior is documented and tested for skills and agents.
privacy: Only aggregate counts are retained here. Local resource bodies were read by an offline probe and were not sent to a provider.
limits: This corpus cannot prove complete YAML compatibility. Duplicate keys and null string values are rejected deliberately; diagnostics may differ.

verification.full: target/yaml-null-full.log: 4574 unit and 21 integration tests passed; 6 existing tests ignored
verification.release: target/yaml-saphyr-release.log: warning-free release build before these test and documentation changes
